goal: Build an evidence-backed learning forest for creating accessible public information dashboards

corrections.statement: Render every domain from top to bottom
corrections.regressionCheck: Every published forest declares layoutDirection as top-to-bottom

corrections.statement: Split the forest into explicit domains instead of attaching everything to one root
corrections.regressionCheck: Every node belongs to one domain and the renderer exposes domain navigation
The audit rejects chapter, unit, page, or partial-resource assignments

corrections.statement: Split compound topics into independently learnable nodes
corrections.regressionCheck: Compound node titles enter the review queue

corrections.statement: Explain three current research frontiers for every node
corrections.regressionCheck: The audit rejects nodes without exactly three traceable frontier positions

corrections.statement: Judge releases through realistic user journeys
corrections.regressionCheck: Every release carries a user-journey review with observed friction and changes

corrections.statement: Show a real dependency tree with visible branches instead of presenting the demo as one chain
corrections.regressionCheck: The renderer exposes at least two dependency levels, multiple domain lanes, and prerequisite edges derived from dependsOn

corrections.statement: Give English and Chinese their own direct demo URLs and do not mix interface languages
corrections.regressionCheck: Both language query URLs are linked and each rendered interface passes a language-leak check

corrections.statement: Use real product screenshots; English documentation shows English UI and Chinese documentation shows Chinese UI
corrections.regressionCheck: README tests require language-suffixed production screenshots and reject cross-language screenshot references

corrections.statement: Use professional terms for depth; do not treat a professional term as its own explanation
corrections.regressionCheck: Every node includes a separate outcome, rationale, inspectable artifact, and observable criteria beyond its title

corrections.statement: Present the repository as a usable product rather than a record of past corrections
corrections.regressionCheck: Public README describes user outcomes, examples, operation, quality and maintenance without exposing private iteration history

corrections.statement: Show real production-site learning cases from several fields and page locations instead of repeating one selected tree position
corrections.regressionCheck: README galleries require distinct field and view identifiers, real public evidence names, language-matched interfaces, varied screenshots, and no private progress or deployment metadata
